description: §19.10.4 (S478; code name confirmed S479) — a `transaction` block in a client-placed `!` function that reaches a query through its server calls is E-TX-CLIENT-PLACED (PERMANENT): no transaction spans two requests.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 21 (b) · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 2 (code name confirmed)
rationale: §19.10.4: "In a `!` function placed on the client (§12.2) whose transitive query set is non-empty … a `transaction { … }` block SHALL be a compile error: **E-TX-CLIENT-PLACED**."
